spec.description: Whether the runner pool keeps up with your CI jobs, and if not, why: the budget, the queue, job times and the pool's own health. It reads manade's metrics page, and sees no queued job of an organization or enterprise scope.

spec.title: manade down
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeDown alert fires: Prometheus has not scraped manade for 5 minutes. No runner starts for queued jobs, and every other panel is out of date. Check the container, the `METRICS_LISTEN_ADDR` port and your scrape job.

spec.title: Start not finished
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeBootStalled alert fires: manade has not finished a start in 30 minutes, because one start never ends or every start fails, so it serves no job. A stalled pull of a runner image or a setting GitHub or Docker refuses is the usual cause, which the log names.

spec.title: Scale set not polled
spec.description: Shows while the ManadePollStalled alert fires: a scale set has had no good poll for 10 minutes, so GitHub assigns it no jobs. The Poll age panel on the Pool health tab names it. Check that GitHub answers and that the credential still works.

spec.title: Scope not served
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeScopeNotServing alert fires: the pool has stopped running jobs for a scope for 10 minutes. The repository turned public, a visibility read failed, or another pool holds its sessions. manade's log names the scope and the cause.

spec.title: Runner starts failing
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeRunnerStartsFailing alert fires: every runner start of a scale set failed in the last 15 minutes. Its jobs wait until a start succeeds. Check the profile's image and Docker, and the runner start lines in the log.

spec.title: Assigned jobs not started
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeAssignedNotStarted alert fires: GitHub assigned jobs to a scale set that no runner took for 10 minutes. GitHub cancels and reassigns them meanwhile. Check runner starts and whether the budget covers the assigned jobs.

spec.title: Queue backed up
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeQueueBackedUp alert fires: the oldest job in the queue has waited over 30 minutes. The budget is full and repository jobs wait their turn. Raise the capacity budget, or look for runners that hang.

spec.title: Queue reads stale
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeQueueReadsStale alert fires: a repository's queued jobs have not been read in full for 15 minutes. The pool funds none of its new jobs until a read succeeds. The usual causes are a missing Actions read permission, a rate limit or a GitHub outage.

spec.title: Runner out of memory
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeRunnerOOMKilled alert fires: the kernel killed a runner at its profile's memory limit in the last hour. Its job ended early. Raise the profile's memory, or make the job use less.

spec.title: Reconciler stalled
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeReconcileStalled alert fires: the reconciler has not finished a pass in 5 minutes. Ended runners keep their reservations, so the pool starts fewer jobs. Check that Docker answers.

spec.title: Runner image stale
spec.description: Shows while the ManadeImageStale alert fires: a profile's image has had no good check for 72 hours, or none since manade started. Its jobs run on an old image, or cannot run at all. Check the registry, its credentials and the image reference.

spec.title: CPUs reserved
spec.description: The share of the CPU budget that live runners reserve. It turns yellow at 90%, where a large job may no longer fit. A full budget beside waiting jobs means the budget is the limit.

spec.title: Memory reserved
spec.description: The share of the memory budget that live runners reserve. It turns yellow at 90%, where a large job may no longer fit. A full budget beside waiting jobs means the budget is the limit.

spec.title: Jobs waiting
spec.description: Repository jobs waiting in the queue for a runner, across every scope and profile. Jobs GitHub has already assigned, and jobs the pool cannot run now, are counted elsewhere. Organization and enterprise jobs are not visible to the pool.

spec.title: Oldest job's wait
spec.description: How long the oldest job in the queue has waited. It turns yellow at 10 minutes and red at 30 minutes, where ManadeQueueBackedUp fires. It reads 0 while no repository job waits.

spec.title: Busy runners
spec.description: Runners running a job now, across every scope and profile. Starting and idle runners are on the Runners by state panel below.

spec.title: Assigned, not started
spec.description: Jobs GitHub has assigned to a scale set that no runner has taken yet. A value above 0 for a few seconds is normal while a runner starts. A value that holds for 10 minutes fires ManadeAssignedNotStarted.

spec.title: Jobs left out
spec.description: Queued jobs the pool leaves out of its queue: those GitHub left unassigned, and those the pool cannot run now. The Jobs left out row on the Pool health tab splits them by cause.

spec.title: Scopes not served
spec.description: Configured scopes whose jobs the pool does not run now. It turns red at 1, and a scope stopped for 10 minutes fires ManadeScopeNotServing. Every scope reads stopped until the start has pulled the runner images and read its visibility, which can take minutes on a first start. ManadeScopeNotServing waits until the start has finished.

spec.title: CPUs reserved against the budget
spec.description: The CPUs live runners reserve, beside the CPU budget. Reserved CPUs stay at the budget while jobs wait for room.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Memory reserved against the budget
spec.description: The memory live runners reserve, beside the memory budget. Reserved memory stays at the budget while jobs wait for room.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Runners by state
spec.description: Live runners by profile and state, stacked. Starting runners wait for GitHub to hand them a job, idle ones have none yet, and busy ones run one. Many idle runners for long means jobs went elsewhere.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Jobs waiting by profile
spec.description: Repository jobs waiting in the queue, by the profile they ask for. A profile that keeps jobs waiting while others run needs more room or a higher limit.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Oldest job's wait
spec.description: How long the oldest job in the queue has waited, over time. The red line at 1800 seconds is where ManadeQueueBackedUp fires.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Queue wait by profile
spec.description: How long jobs waited from queueing to their runner, by profile, as the median and the 95th percentile. A rising 95th percentile with a flat median means a few jobs wait for room.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Job duration by profile
spec.description: How long jobs ran from runner assignment to their end, by profile, as the median and the 95th percentile. A jump after an image or workflow change is worth a look.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Jobs finished by result
spec.description: Jobs that finished on the pool, by their result. Canceled includes jobs a user canceled, and other covers results GitHub adds later.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Runner starts by result
spec.description: Runner start attempts, by result. Errors beside good starts are retried. Errors with no good start fire ManadeRunnerStartsFailing.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Runner exits by reason
spec.description: How runners ended: completed or failed jobs, out of memory, past their lifetime, idle, or lost. Lost means the container vanished without the pool seeing it exit.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Out of memory kills by profile
spec.description: Runners the kernel killed at their memory limit, by profile. Any kill fires ManadeRunnerOOMKilled, and raising the profile's memory is the usual fix.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: GitHub errors by call
spec.description: Failed GitHub calls, by the kind of call. Queue errors are the queued-jobs reads, which a rate limit or a missing permission fails.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Docker errors by call
spec.description: Failed Docker Engine calls, by the kind of call. Pull errors point at the registry, and create or start errors at the profile.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Poll age by scale set
spec.description: Seconds since each scale set last polled GitHub well. The red line at 300 seconds is where ManadePollStalled starts counting. While manade starts, the age runs from the start and the alert waits.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Queue read age by repository
spec.description: Seconds since each repository scope last had its queued jobs read in full. The red line at 300 seconds is where ManadeQueueReadsStale starts counting. While manade starts, the age runs from the start and the alert waits.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Image check age by profile
spec.description: Hours since each profile's image was last checked well. The red line at 72 hours is where ManadeImageStale starts counting. A profile whose image was never pulled has no line here.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Unassignable jobs by scale set
spec.description: Queued jobs GitHub left unassigned though the pool funded a slot for two polls. Another runner with the same label may take them. Each is retried after 10 minutes, and the log names its run.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Unfundable jobs by reason
spec.description: Queued jobs the pool cannot run now, by reason, stacked. The profile may not be allowed in the scope, the scope may not be served, or the image may be missing.

defaults.noValue: No data from manade in this range

spec.title: Elevated profiles
spec.description: Each profile that sets an elevated field, with the field it sets. These profiles give their jobs more access to the host, so check each is meant.

defaults.noValue: No profile sets an elevated field

spec.title: Orphaned scale sets
spec.description: Scale sets in a scope that the config no longer names, as found at the last start. They stay on GitHub until you delete them, and a workflow that still targets one waits forever.

spec.title: manade

spec.name: attention
spec.label: Attention tiles shown
spec.description: How many Needs attention tiles have data. The row shows only while one does.
